001package pkg_commands;
002
003import java.util.StringTokenizer;
004
005/**
006 * Converts raw user input into executable command objects.
007 *
008 * <p>The parser reads at most two tokens: the command word and one optional argument.
009 *
010 * @author Michael Kolling and David J. Barnes + D. Bureau
011 * @version 2008.03.30 + 2013.09.15
012 */
013public class Parser {
014    /** Catalogue of valid primary command words. */
015    private CommandWords aCommand;
016
017    /** Prepares the internal {@link CommandWords} table used during parsing. */
018    public Parser() {
019        this.aCommand = new CommandWords();
020    } // Parser()
021
022    /**
023     * Tokenizes {@code pInputLine} and builds the corresponding {@link Command}.
024     *
025     * @param pInput raw user text; may be {@code null}, empty, or multi-word
026     * @return a populated {@link Command}, possibly marked unknown
027     */
028    public Command getCommand(final String pInput) {
029        String vInputLine = pInput;
030        String vWord1;
031        String vWord2;
032
033        StringTokenizer tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(vInputLine);
034
035        if (tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
036            vWord1 = tokenizer.nextToken();
037        } else {
038            vWord1 = null;
039        }
040
041        if (tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
042            vWord2 = tokenizer.nextToken();
043        } else {
044            vWord2 = null;
045        }
046
047        if (this.aCommand.isCommand(vWord1) == false) {
048            return null;
049        }
050
051        Command vCommand = this.aCommand.get(vWord1);
052        if (vCommand != null) {
053            vCommand.setSecondWord(vWord2);
054        }
055
056        return vCommand;
057    } // getCommand()
058
059    /**
060     * Returns a space-separated list of all valid command words.
061     *
062     * @return human-readable command summary suitable for help text
063     */
064    public String getCommandString() {
065        return this.aCommand.getCommandList();
066    } // getCommandString()
067} // Parser
